d: Armenia is searching for new weapons, mainly kamikaze drones, and is looking at new defence partners. As per Armenian media reports, India’s Divyastra has been selected by Armenian officials, citing its low cost, AI compatibility and swarm attack capabilities. The Divyastra is a family of long-range kamikaze drones with three main versions — Mk-1, Mk-2 and Mk-3, with Mk-3 being jet-powered. If the deal materialises, Armenia would further increase its India-made arsenal, already including Pinaka, ATAGS, MArG, Akash, Zen, Swathi and ALS-50.
